news_items.headline: Corpay partners with BVNK to add stablecoin wallets
news_items.summary: Corpay announced a partnership with BVNK to integrate stablecoin wallet capability, extending its cross-border payments stack.

news_items.headline: Corpay highlights cross-border business in new investor presentation
news_items.summary: Company published a new investor deck focused on cross-border segment growth and the Alpha Group acquisition contribution.

news_items.headline: Corpay price target raised to $400 from $390 at Morgan Stanley
news_items.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its 12-month price target on CPAY to $400 from $390, maintaining a constructive stance post-Q1.

news_items.headline: Corpay price target raised to $380 from $377 at BofA
news_items.summary: Bank of America raised its price target on CPAY to $380 from $377 following Q1 beat and raised guidance.

news_items.headline: Loop Capital initiates Corpay with Buy rating, $406 PT
news_items.summary: Loop Capital initiated coverage on CPAY with a Buy rating and a $406 price target, citing corporate payments and cross-border growth.

news_items.headline: Corpay shareholders back board and auditor amid pay scrutiny
news_items.summary: At the annual meeting, shareholders re-elected the board and ratified the auditor despite scrutiny over executive compensation.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Loop Capital initiated Buy with $406 PT (~2026-05-15); Morgan Stanley raised PT to $400 from $390; BofA raised PT to $380 from $377. Consensus 9 buy / 3 hold / 0 sell.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported 2026-05-07: EPS $5.80 vs $5.50 consensus, revenue $1.26B vs $1.21B est (+25.4% YoY), shares +11.2% post-print (already priced in). FY2026 guidance raised: EPS $26.30-$27.10, revenue ~$5.3B. Street expects continued cross-border and corporate payments momentum from Alpha Group + Mastercard $300M partnership; key risk is Alpha/GPS/Paymerang integration cost.
